user.title: Who is taking part?
user.description: ChallengeHouse adds a Fitness page to the sidebar and scores workouts. Tick everyone who takes part: each person gets their own score. Anyone you leave out can still look at the household page.

person.title: Set up a person
person.description: Set up {name}. The step sensor counts daily steps; the phone's Home Assistant app makes one when its step counter is turned on.{warning}

group.description: Two people can compete and cheer together as a couple.

data.group: Group these two as a couple

opengym.title: Gym tracking with openGym?
opengym.description: openGym logs gym sessions. It is optional and can be added later in the ChallengeHouse options.

install.title: Install openGym in Home Assistant
install.description:
openGym runs as an app next to Home Assistant and opens at Home Assistant's address followed by the app's name. Give the HTTPS address people open Home Assistant at from anywhere, for example Home Assistant Cloud's or your own domain.

This address can never change once people have signed up: a passkey only works at the address it was made for.

menu_options.pair: Pair with an openGym that runs elsewhere

install_pair.title: Pair with the new openGym
install_pair.description:
openGym is installed and running.

1. In Chrome (or another browser, not the Home Assistant app), open openGym from the sidebar.
2. Choose Create new profile: the first profile becomes the admin.
3. Go to Settings -> Account -> Pair the mobile app and paste the code here.

To go on without gym tracking, tick the box below and submit; the app stays installed and can be paired later in the ChallengeHouse options.

pair.title: Pair with openGym
pair.description:
openGym needs its own HTTPS address that never changes: a passkey only works at the address it was made for.

1. Open openGym and create your account. The first account becomes the admin.
2. Go to Settings, Account, Pair the mobile app.
3. Paste the code here, with openGym's address.

To go on without gym tracking (for example when pairing fails), tick the box below and submit; openGym can be paired later in the ChallengeHouse options.

gym_people.title: Who uses openGym?
gym_people.description: Pick each person's openGym account, or invite someone who has none yet: ChallengeHouse makes a sign-up code and shows it to them later. Leave Nobody for a person without openGym.

error.invalid_code: openGym did not accept this pairing code. Codes are 4 to 16 letters and digits; make a new one in openGym if it expired.
error.cannot_connect: openGym could not be reached at this address.
error.duplicate_gym_user: Each openGym account can belong to one person only.
error.invite_failed: openGym could not make an invite. Check that it is running, or choose Nobody and invite later.
error.address_https: Give the https address you open Home Assistant at, without a path, for example https://home.example.com.
error.app_unavailable: Couldn't fetch the openGym app. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.app_install_failed: Home Assistant could not install the openGym app. Its log (Settings -> System -> Logs, Supervisor) says why.
error.app_start_failed: The openGym app is installed but did not start. Its log (Settings -> Apps -> openGym) says why.

progress.install_app: Installing openGym. Home Assistant builds it on this machine; this takes a minute or two.

gym_people.title: openGym users and invites
gym_people.description: Pick each person's openGym user; their gym sessions count as workouts. For someone without an openGym account, choose Invite: ChallengeHouse makes a sign-up code and shows it to them later. Inviting again stops the old code working. Leave Nobody for a person without openGym.

abort.waiting_for_fitbridge: Waiting for fitbridge: it knows no people yet. Try again in a minute; check the log if scoring.toml is invalid, or add a person under People.
abort.people_not_migrated: The people are still read from scoring.toml because it could not be moved into these options. Check the log, fix the file and restart Home Assistant.
abort.no_free_users: Every Home Assistant user is already a viewer of a person. Free one in Who is who first.

opengym_token.title: openGym rejected the token
opengym_token.description: fitbridge could not read openGym because the token was rejected. Gym sessions come from the last good fetch until fitbridge is paired with openGym again.

folder_missing.description: ChallengeHouse cannot find {folder}, the watch folder for {person}, so it is not scanned. Other inputs go on. Restore the folder, or change or clear it in the ChallengeHouse options (Webhooks and watch folders).
